# Loryfy

> Loryfy is a mobile-first business discovery and networking platform operating across the United Arab Emirates.

Loryfy connects owners of operational running businesses, startup founders, and entrepreneurs directly with potential funding, strategic, and operating partners, investors, and buyers across the UAE.

Key discovery needs include finding funding partners providing equity or capital contribution, strategic partners offering industry networks and market expansion, and operating partners acting as hands-on executives. Users can discover running businesses with existing premises, staff, and cash flow across the UAE, explore validated startup opportunities and business ideas seeking co-founders, or browse mainland and free zone trade licenses for sale and transfer. Under current commercial terms, users can list running businesses, startup ideas, and trade licenses at no cost to connect directly with interested parties through direct in-app messaging.

Loryfy provides equal-priority discovery and bilingual interfaces in both English and Arabic. Contact email is info@loryfy.com.
